Class Mark

java.lang.Object
project.models.others.Mark
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Mark extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a student's academic mark for a course. Total = firstAttestation (30%) + secondAttestation (30%) + finalExam (40%). Pass threshold: total >= 50.
